source_instruction: i am looking for a women's socks made up of polyester cotton which is washable in machine. also choose black or semi mint rush green color.
query: Ugh, I swear my cat knocked over my entire matcha latte all over my desk this morning, I had to rush to wipe down my laptop and my favorite poetry chapbook before the stain set, and now I’m running so late I almost forgot to pick up the stuff I need for my upcoming weekend hike. Oh right, I need to grab some pairs from the women's socks & hosiery section: they have to be dry clean only, made of polyester cotton, come in black, semi turbo pink, or semi mint rush green, and can’t cost more than $30 total. Wait, did I remember to toss my stained hoodie in the laundry hamper before I left? I can’t remember.
